checked_summary:
I checked sections 0–8 of /home/user/Brainaccess-HALO-eeg-analysis/reports/INITIAL_ANALYSIS.md against the sources and found 9 discrepancies: 3 errors, 1 overstatement and 5 minor.

**Errors**
- §0 says V-03 covered all 19 pipelines. The run has only 18 (EA + sustained Cov-TS was never run; F6 got 3 reps). The 0.331–0.347 range is right for those 18.
- §8 gives the cross-day range as 36.0–40.6%. generalization.csv has 33.3 as the minimum (P003, 4-channel, no alignment).
- §2 describes the Board 3.0.0 stream reference as recorded with the device not worn. The JSON names its source as P003's main run-05 XDF from 2026-11-21, a worn recording.

**Overstatement**
- §6 inference item 2 treats ~16 ms jitter as present on the .db path. That figure is the interval SD of the live LSL stream. The audit says .db jitter is undocumented and suggests marker-position jitter is mostly under 10 ms.

**Minor**
- The rgb-ml-analysis commit date is given as 2026-11-25~26; it was committed only on 11-25 (79f7a48).
- The §4 header mentions a Board column that the table does not have.
- §3 calls the gray1 count UNKNOWN, but controls.csv gives clean counts for three subjects (115/87/60).
- §7 says "sLDA 외 18종"; that counts pipelines, while there are 8 distinct classifiers.
- §1 attributes the quoted phrase "팀 승인 전" to all three open decisions; plan_changes.md uses it only for the P003 block combination.

**What checks out**
- **Stored results:** all 5 CSVs, their shapes, the 28/28 consistency checks, and the session/trial/valid counts (1,608 / 1,428 / 995; 533/243/136/83). Keep-rate percentages, the class balance in the ERP figure legend, the p-values and Bonferroni values, and the methods means (33.8 / 39.6) also match.
- **Line references and quotes:** every one in these sections matches the code (ba_io.py, build_cache.py, build_epochs.py, run_extra.py, stim_rgb.py, protocol.py), as do the epoch geometry (840 samples) and feature dimensions (36/18/20/32/64).
- **Plan and history:** the pre-registered values in protocol.json and research_context.md, the plan_changes and CHANGELOG facts, P02's exclusion reason, the 33 rgb-eeg-lab tests (counted from the test file, not run), the SART commit history, and the V-03b/V-04/V-04b numbers (39.4%, 51.4%, 100%, CIs including 1/3).
- **Data access:** the claim of no raw data holds; /mnt/user-data is empty and list_computer_folders returns an empty list.

**Not checked:** the 26.6 s test runtime and the external "연구 프로토콜 §9" reference.

I checked every number, line reference and factual claim in INITIAL_ANALYSIS.md §9–§15 and in reports/README.md against the sources. Eleven discrepancies remain, listed in issues: three errors, three overstatements and five minor wording problems.

Checked against run outputs (V01–V04c run.json, stdout.log and CSVs):
- V-01: 28/28 checks; null SD 2.55–5.90; ratio to iid SD 1.14–1.29; the leave-one-subject-out pick is ERP O1·O2 + sLDA every time, mean 39.58; Kendall's W 0.409.
- V-02: Michelson contrast −0.39/−0.58/−0.07%; S-cone contrast for B 11.076.
- V-03: null means 0.331–0.347, max t 2.63.
- V-03b: 0.334/0.335 with CIs that include 1/3; 0.385/0.394 at 3 µV; SD ratio 1.11–1.28.
- V-04: 0.206 / 0.3935; false-positive rate 0–0.10; carry-over 0.3388.
- V-04b: 0.514, last position 1.000.
- V-04c: all values match.

Checked against stored results:
- methods.csv: deltas −3.3 to +5.8; baseline 33.8.
- subjects.csv: P002 Bonferroni p 0.019; mixed 1000/200 permutations.
- sessions.csv: keep rates 22–24% and 98–99%.
- controls.csv: n 115/87/60.
- erp_by_colour.png legend: 24–46 trials per colour.
- gray1 keep rate 115/270 = 42.6% vs obs 533/540 = 98.7%.

Checked against code: rgb_pipeline.py:171-235, build_epochs.py:5, :5-15, :38, :40 and :48-49, train_svm.py:65-71, and the grep showing that only results_within_*/extra/perm/perm_fine CSVs are written by code.

Checked against docs and other sources: research_context.md:39, plan_changes.md:29/40/55/56/57/75, the CHANGELOG 2026-11-03 21:02 entry, rgb-ml-analysis/README.md:22, REPORT.md:108/110, the CLAUDE.md/CHECKLIST.md IRB rule, hostname and username in locks/ and the README. The audit JSON gives 37 findings: 21 CONFIRMED, 16 PLAUSIBLE; adjusted severity critical 1, major 17, minor 19; statistics-01 is the critical, CONFIRMED. The README run timings match run.json, the 33 tests match 31 test functions with one 3-case parametrize, make_manifest arguments match, and RESEARCH_MAP has 14 areas and E01–E20. Bibliographic details of the references are consistent with known citations.

Main problems:
- **Error:** V-03 is described as covering 19 pipelines in §9 L1, §15.1 and the README. It actually tested 18: 'EA + 지속반응' was never run, and F6 ran only 3 reps.
- **Overstatements:**
  - L8 states as fact that the 150 µV threshold was chosen from keep rates; the audit verifiers say this cannot be shown.
  - §11 blames P001's low keep rate on the PTP threshold alone; the stored data cannot separate it from contact loss.
  - §15.2 lists the twin-block and permutation findings without their PLAUSIBLE label.
- **Minor:**
  - L3 says records 'before' 11-24 rather than 'up to' 11-24.
  - L3 gives the V-04 B range as if it were the identical-schedule range.
  - V-02 calls the Michelson contrast a 'luminance difference'.
  - §15.2 calls the P003 combination proposal a 'team proposal'; it is Claude's, pending team approval.
  - The README describes INITIAL_ANALYSIS as 10 items when it has 15 sections.

No files were modified.

checked_summary:
I checked every numeric result in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md digit by digit against reports/runs/V01, V02, V03, V03b, V04, V04b and V04c (run.json, stdout.log, *.csv), and recomputed the arithmetic with python3. That covered the V-01 null-SD ratios, LOSO mean, Kendall W, cells above null95 and the 28/28 checks; the V-02 Y_rel, Michelson and cone contrasts (recomputed from the script's matrices); the V-03 means, t values, SD range, signal-minus-null deltas and score shape; the V-03b CIs and p values; the V-04 A/B/C/D values; the V-04b decoders and per-position accuracies; and the V-04c oracle values. I checked the claims against the validation scripts, _synth.py, rgb_pipeline.py, protocol.json/protocol.py, plan_changes.md, research_context.md, the stored results CSVs, the audit JSON (cv-leakage-01 is PLAUSIBLE; it has 5 dimensions, i.e. 5 auditors and 5 verifiers) and git history. All file SHA-256 values in run.json match the current files.

EVALUATION_PROTOCOL §1 matches protocol.json and research_context.md: ERSP, Morlet 3 cycles, 3–30 Hz, 4×4 bins, the SVM grid, causal 4th-order 1–30 Hz filter, −1 to 2 s epoch, −1.8 to −1.0 s baseline, 60/120/0.5 µV QC, 5-fold outer CV, BA primary metric, 10,000-iteration bootstrap. The 1.11–1.28 and 1.14–1.29 ratios and the 51.4%/100% values match the run outputs.

Main problems:
- **Git HEAD:** V-03b through V-04c ran at 74c22d5, not ad39d1d, and three of the scripts are not in the first report commit.
- **V-03 pipeline count:** V-03 evaluated 18 of the 19 pipelines ('EA + 지속반응' is missing), but both documents say 19.
- **Calibration rule:** the protocol's ±2 SE rule contradicts V-03's 3 SE criterion. Under ±2 SE, 4 pipelines fail.
- **V-03 sensitivity sentence:** it misstates the ERP gains (+1–3 %p, not +1–2) and leaves out xDAWN-cov+MDM, which rose to 0.353.
- **P002 seed:** the shared seed for P002's repeated sessions is stated as fact, although P002_1125's seed is unknown.
- **Minor:** several rounding, wording and scope slips.

I read every file under reports/: the README, INITIAL_ANALYSIS, EVALUATION_PROTOCOL, RESEARCH_MAP, EXPERIMENT_LOG, STOP_REPORT, AUDIT_FINDINGS, all seven runs/*/run.json with their stdout.log and result CSVs, the audit JSON (structure and identifier grep) and the three PNG figures. I also read every script under research/. I made no changes. I checked these things directly: the recorded SHA-256 hashes against the current files (all match), which commit each script went into, V-03 summary.csv and scores.csv (only 18 pipelines; F6 has 3 null reps), V-04 C_summary (false-positive rates from 20 reps), the V-04c tie-break logic, and a repo-wide grep for the hostname, Windows profile name and exact recording times.

What is compliant:
- RESEARCH_MAP covers all 14 required areas, each with problem, feasibility, effect, cost and priority, plus a budgeted E01–E20 list.
- INITIAL_ANALYSIS covers 10 of the required topics and marks UNKNOWN where it should.
- STOP_REPORT gives stop reasons, next actions and the three-way split of conclusions.
- The Macro-F1 vs BA question is correctly raised for approval, not decided unilaterally.
- No raw data was used or sent out, and the synthetic figures carry a "not real EEG" note.

The main gaps:
1. The "all 19 pipelines" null-calibration claim is false: 18 were run, and F6 had only 3 reps.
2. The protocol's own ±2 SE leakage rule would mark the baseline INVALID using V-03's own numbers.
3. No evaluation script is fixed.
4. No error logs are kept: stderr is not captured and the V-03/V-04 scripts suppress warnings.
5. The git commit is mis-recorded for 4 runs.
6. Some inferences and simulation results are presented as verified facts or counter-evidence.
7. No figure has an interpretation, and the V-04 figure has further gaps.
8. The Windows profile name, the hostname and exact recording times are copied into the shareable reports.
9. Smaller items: shapes and configs missing from several runs, the audit has no run record, the manifest hash includes mtime, and the stimulus timeline is not described.
